incident_text: A big fire is burning on this street tonight.

result.scene_summary: A narrow street at night, lined with dark brick buildings featuring white-framed windows and illuminated by street lamps and interior lights.

observations.description: Row of dark brick buildings with white-framed windows and doors.
Street lamps mounted on the buildings, emitting bright light.
Flower boxes with red flowers mounted on building facades.
Dark, empty street with no visible activity.
Windows on upper floors are lit from within.
